description: Reads and manages Gerrit code reviews over the HTTPS REST API: change metadata and diffs, inline comments and drafts, reviewers and CCs, labels and votes, checks, topics, hashtags, commit messages, cherry-picks, abandon, and submit. Use when working with Android (AOSP), Chromium, Fuchsia, or self-hosted Gerrit, when given a Gerrit change URL (https://*-review.googlesource.com/*, https://r.android.com/*, https://crrev.com/c/*, https://fxrev.dev/*, or https://*/c/*/+/*), or when git commands target a Gerrit host (refs/for/ pushes or branch cherry-picks). Don't use for local-only git operations or GitHub and GitLab pull requests.
